title: Marketing launch polish: legal, status, nav, pricing
description:
## Problem
chattic.us is moving from early prototype to product launch. A launch-readiness review of the homepage header/footer found legal/support gaps, beta vs production messaging conflict, unclear entry CTAs, buried pricing, and missing mobile nav.

## Scope (child tasks)
1. Legal + support surfaces (Privacy, Terms, Support via GitHub Issues for now)
2. Footer + FAQ: say we are in beta (not \"live in production\")
3. Clarify entry path CTAs (Sign in vs Join the beta)
4. Surface Pricing in primary nav
5. Restore accessible mobile navigation

## Out of scope
- Replacing GitHub Issues with a first-party support inbox (separate follow-up story)
- Public wiki / blog work already in flight elsewhere
- Visual redesign of the marketing site

## Done when
All child tasks closed; marketing copy is consistent about beta; legal/support links exist; Pricing and mobile nav work; changes on develop (and main when product owner merges).
